<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Incorrect Purchase Order on Invoices",
 "problem_statement": "Customers face reconciliation and payment delays because invoices contain wrong purchase order numbers. This mismatch disrupts finance workflows and blocks timely payments."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 4,
 "mentions_n": 5,
 "routes_n": 2,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "support": 4,
  "sales": 1
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 2442000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 2,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Greystock Liability",
   "arr_gbp": 92000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-01-25",
   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Penhallow Specialty Risks",
   "arr_gbp": 230000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-06-18",
   "mentions": 2
  },
  {
   "name": "Elderfold Home",
   "arr_gbp": 170000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2026-12-21",
   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Wexmoor Motor",
   "arr_gbp": 1950000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-06-30",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "08446157bc83c428",
  "quote": "I’m trying to get our purchase order number updated on your latest invoice — it’s currently wrong and needs to reflect our internal tracking correctly.",
  "account": "Greystock Liability",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-30T15:57:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "6d04624fe10d4f44",
  "quote": "we need to update the purchase order reference on our most recent invoice — it’s causing reconciliation issues with our finance team.",
  "account": "Penhallow Specialty Risks",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-11T12:00:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "99ed668a91f6c801",
  "quote": "I’m writing to request an update to the purchase order number on your invoice — this is causing reconciliation issues, and I need the invoice contact change reflected accurately in our records.",
  "account": "Elderfold Home",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-06T09:09:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "beb81f30363d1f4d",
  "quote": "We need to adjust the purchase order reference on the invoice you sent — it’s causing reconciliation problems with our finance team, and we’re hoping you can help with the purchase order correction.",
  "account": "Penhallow Specialty Risks",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-11T12:00:00+00:00"
 },
 {
  "id": "f7561e6a446002ad",
  "quote": "The PO we referenced doesn’t match what’s on your billing, and it’s blocking our payment cycle.",
  "account": "Wexmoor Motor",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-30T15:59:00Z"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Customers face reconciliation and payment delays because invoices contain wrong purchase order numbers. This mismatch disrupts finance workflows and blocks timely payments.

## Who is affected
- Four accounts have reported this issue [i:08446157bc83c428][i:6d04624fe10d4f44][i:99ed668a91f6c801][i:beb81f30363d1f4d][i:f7561e6a446002ad].
- The issue has been raised through two routes: support and sales [i:08446157bc83c428][i:6d04624fe10d4d44][i:f7561e6a446002ad].

## Evidence
- Greystock Liability (ARR GBP 92000.0) requested an update because the purchase order number on the invoice is currently wrong and needs to reflect their internal tracking correctly [i:08446157bc83c428].
- Penhallow Specialty Risks (ARR GBP 230000.0) stated the wrong purchase order reference is causing reconciliation issues with their finance team [i:6d04624fe10d4f44][i:beb81f30363d1f4d].
- Elderfold Home (ARR GBP 170000.0) reported the issue is causing reconciliation problems and needs the invoice contact change reflected accurately [i:99ed668a91f6c801].
- Wexmoor Motor (ARR GBP 1950000.0) stated the mismatch is blocking their payment cycle [i:f7561e6a446002ad].
- The problem has been mentioned five times across four accounts [i:08446157bc83c428][i:6d04624fe10d4f44][i:99ed668a91f6c801][i:beb81f30363d1f4d][i:f7561e6a446002ad].
- Four of the five mentions came through the support route, and one came through sales [i:08446157bc83c428][i:6d04624fe10d4f44][i:99ed668a91f6c801][i:beb81f30363d1f4d][i:f7561e6a446002ad].
- The total ARR of the reporting accounts is GBP 2442000.0.

## Why now
- Two of the affected accounts, Elderfold Home and Greystock Liability, have renewals coming up within the next 90 days, on 2026-12-21 and 2027-01-25 respectively.
- The most recent report was from Wexmoor Motor on 2026-10-30 [i:f7561e6a446002ad].
- The issue has been reported consistently from late September to late October 2026, indicating it is an ongoing, active pain point for customers [i:08446157bc83c428][i:99ed668a91f6c801][i:6d04624fe10d4f44][i:beb81f30363d1f4d][i:f7561e6a446002ad].",
  "citations": ["08446157bc83c428", "6d04624fe10d4f44", "99ed668a91f6c801", "beb81f30363d1f4d", "f7561e6a446002ad"]
}
